action.description: Select one of this operation's supported actions. Mutating actions change durable state.

content.description: The text stored in this item. For ingestion it must be the actual verbatim interaction.

kind.description: The memory's semantic type. Remember defaults to fact; corrections inherit the inspected type.

memory_id.description: A memory ID returned by Stowage. Do not invent one.

review.description: For the legacy assertion escape hatch: true leaves an unsupported assertion pending human/curator review.
